metadata.title: If You Can Smell Your Laundry Scent, Is It Harming Your Air? | Tide
metadata.description: Learn why being able to smell a laundry fragrance does not mean harmful exposure, how rinse-off laundry products work, what VOCs are, and why fragrance emissions from laundry are a small contributor to indoor air quality.
